newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS up 5.5 percent, various reasons cited.
newsitem.headline: SAS up 5.5 percent, various reasons cited.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System SASb.CO (SAS) share prices climbed 5.5 percent on Thursday but dealers disagreed as to the likely cause.
At 1300 GMT the share stood at 95.00 crowns, up 5.00 from Wednesday's 90.00 close, in turnover of 307,000 shares traded.

Some dealers said that the rise was due to strong passenger volume figures released on Thursday by Copenhagen Airports. Some said the price was boosted by buy recommendations from London banks and others said that an unknown foreign buyer was snapping up the stock, thereby driving up the price.
